RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, December 1, 2010/Agrahayana 10, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Road Transport and Highways; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Implementation of Toll Rules, 1977
*301. SHRI T.M.
SELVAGANAPATHI: Will the Minister
of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the All India
Motor Transport Congress has demanded
implementation of the Toll Rules, 1977
pertaining to vehicles category and toll rates
on National Highways;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that they
have threatened to go on strike from
December 5, 2010 on their demands not
being met; and
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government
in this regard?
Restrictive laws in European
countries on export of
non-patented medicines
†*302. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
restrictive laws in European countries on
non-patented medicines being exported
from the country;
(b) if so, the facts in this regard;
(c) the value of medicines exported by
India which have been left in the lurch under
this law; and
(d) whether European countries have
now assured to remove this restriction; if
so, by when the assurance will be effective?
Patent of traditional Indian
toothpowder
*303. SHRI ISHWAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether a Multinational Company
(MNC) has patented the traditional Indian
'Lal Dant Manjan' in the United States on
the basis of an application filed in India in
2005;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

93
(b) whether the Controller General of
Patents in India has yet to decide on the
MNC's application filed in 2005;
(c) whether the Association of
Manufacturers of Ayurvedic Medicines has
challenged the application filed by the
MNC in India in 2005; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Inter-State border problem in North-
East
*304. SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD
BAISHYA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Central Government is
aware that the life and property of people
in Assam bordering Arunachal Pradesh,
Nagaland and Meghalaya are all the time
gripped by tension following encroachment
and violence caused by suspected groups;
(b)  if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what specific measures have been
taken by Central Government to solve this
Inter-State border problem and to save the
residents of Assam?
Proposal to amend the Central
Lotteries Act
*305. PROF. P.J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any State Government has
approached the Union Government to
amend the Central Lotteries Act;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that State
Governments do not have adequate powers
to take action against those who violate the
provisions of the Lotteries Act;
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(e) the action the Union Government
proposes to take in this regard?
Special policy to modernize police
force of Jharkhand
*306. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any special
policy to modernize the police force of
Jharkhand;
(b) if so, the funds released for the same
during the last three years to Jharkhand,
year-wise and component-wise; and
(c) the details of new plans Government
is contemplating to tackle naxal menace in
Jharkhand?
Feasibility study of Surat-Mumbai
National Express Highway Project
*307. SHRI BHARATSINH
PRABHATSINH PARMAR: W ill the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the progress of the feasibility study
of the Surat-Mumbai National Express
Highway Project which was submitted in
the year 1991 in view of its national
importance and was finalised by the then
Union Government on priority basis;
(b) the outcome of the study as on date
and the reasons for undue delay;
(c) whether the final decision had been
taken by the Cabinet Committee in 1991
and Government of Gujarat had frozen land
in 300 metres width along with proposed
alignment in that year only; and
(d) by when the proposal is likely to be
finalised?

94
Invoking para 3 of Part A of Fifth
Schedule of the Constitution
*308. SHRI MANI SHANKAR
AIY AR: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has considered
the question of invoking para 3 of Part A of
the Fifth Schedule of the Constitution to
issue directions to States for compliance
with the Provisions of the Panchayats
(Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996;
(b) whether Government has put in
place mechanisms to monitor such
compliance; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
ensure such compliance in Union
Territories?
Hundred per cent FDI in single brand
retail
*309. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is going to allow 100 per cent FDI in single
brand retail business;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has made any
assessment about the impact of this on the
country's economy; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
ITIs for LWE districts of Gujarat
*310. SHRI NATUJI HALAJI
THAKOR: Will the Minister of LABOUR
AND EMPLOYMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of ITIs sanctioned for
Gujarat specially for the Left Wing
Extremism (LWE) affected districts,
indicating the details thereof, district-wise
and year-wise for the last three years;
(b) whether any priority has been given
to Bharuch, Amreli, Mehsana, Rajkot,
Vadodara and Surat districts under these
sanctions during that period;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the status of this project, indicating
district-wise and year-wise details?
Review of AFSPA in Manipur
*311. SHRI M.P. ACHUTHAN: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Government constituted Justice Jeevan
Reddy Commission to review the Armed
Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958
(AFSPA) in Manipur;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the said
Commission had clearly suggested for the
repeal of the AFSPA from Manipur;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the details of the reasons why this
Act has not been repealed till date?
Overhauling of regulatory system of
transport
*312. SHRI TARIQ ANW AR: Will the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 15 persons
lose their lives in the accidents every hour
in the country;
(b) if so, the total number of persons
who have lost their lives during the last
three years, State-wise; and

95
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) the steps Government is taking to
overhaul the regulatory system of transport
in the country?
Procurement of Howitzers in violation
of DP Manual
*313. SHRI JAI PRAKASH
NARAYAN SINGH: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
violation of Defence Procurement Manual,
2009 in procurement of Ultra Light
Howitzers from BAE Systems;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether BAE Systems has been
dogged in  unethical practices and dealings
in many countries and has been charged for
bribery by many countries; and
(d) if so, the reasons for procuring
Howitzers from such a company, in
violation of Defence Manual?
Interlocutors on various disturbed
States
*314. DR. E.M. SUDARSANA
NATCHIAPPAN: Wi ll the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has appointed
interlocutors on various disturbed States
to have talks with the various armed groups
and activists; and
(b) if so, the details of progress and
impact thereof, specifically in respect of
Jammu and Kashmir and North-East
States?
Slump in industrial growth rate
*315. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether industrial growth rate
slumped to 5.6 per cent recently;
(b) if so, the item-wise details thereof
and the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken to boost the
growth during the remaining part of the
Eleventh Plan?
Review of financial assistance
schemes under APEDA
*316. SHRI Y .S. CHOWDARY: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of financial assistance
schemes that are available under Agriculture
and Processed Food Products Export
Development Authority (APEDA);
(b) whether Government has
undertaken any review to ensure that the
financial assistance schemes serve the
purpose for which they are intended;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the monitoring mechanism in place
in the Ministry to oversee the whole gamut
of schemes that are being implemented?
Stability in industrial
growth rate
†*317. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that stability
could not be achieved in industrial growth
rate in the country so far;
(b) if so, the Government's reaction in
this regard; and
(c) the months during April, 2008 to
September, 2010 when the industrial growth
rate has remained maximum and minimum?

96
Permission to States to establish SEZs
†*318. SHRI Y . P. TRIVEDI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Central Government has
given permission to State Governments to
establish several new Special Economic
Zones (SEZs);
(b) if so, when and the State-wise
numbers thereof; and
(c) the details of the number of SEZs
out of these for State of Maharashtra and
places where Government has permitted
to establish them?
Stopping collection of toll tax on
potholed NHs
*319. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister
of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
stop toll tax collections on potholed
National Highways and other roads in the
country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Objections of States on signing SSA
with  NHAI
†*320. SHRI BALAV ANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether several States, including
Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Orissa,
Gujarat, Bihar and Tamil Nadu, have
registered their objections on signing State
Support Agreement (SSA) with National
Highways Authority of India (NHAI);
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether there is an apprehension
that the above said agreement may stop
the State Governments from carrying out
important road development work; and
(d) if so, the reaction of the Central
Government thereto?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 25th November, 2010 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 4, 1932 (Saka)

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Commerce and Industry : 302, 303, 309, 315, 316, 317, 318,
Defence : 313,
Home Affairs : 304, 305, 306, 308, 311, 314,
Labour and Employment : 310,
Road Transport and Highways : 301, 307, 312, 319, 320.
